core.title: The roastery rep who left
core.setting: Bookstore manager at Lantern Books, an independent shop with a café

events.text: House rule: no change to a confirmed partner event at Lantern Books — its date, its room, or its named host — without that partner's written agreement first.
Hello from Hearth & Vine Roastery. I'm Tessa Vale, your new account rep — tessa.vale@hearthvine.example, 01473 555 018. Reminder that delivery is free on any order over 150 pounds.
The Café Room at Lantern Books seats 40 and can be booked for evening events until 22:00.
Any supplier order over 500 pounds needs Priya Nair's sign-off before it is placed.
The Tuesday Readers book club meets on the first Tuesday of each month at 18:30; please keep booking us the Café Room.
Set up a standing weekly order with Hearth & Vine Roastery: 4 kg of house blend beans delivered every Thursday to the café, with Tessa Vale as our named contact there.
Nimbus Paper quotes 28 pounds per box of 500 printed Lantern Books carrier bags, minimum four boxes.
Jo works Thursdays to Saturdays in the café and can receive the Thursday bean delivery.
Order 12 kg of Hearth & Vine beans as festival stock for 168 pounds; delivery is free because the order is over their 150-pound threshold.
Confirmed with our roastery account rep: a Meet the Roaster cupping evening hosted for us by Tessa Vale of Hearth & Vine in the Café Room on Friday 20 November, 19:00 start.
Staff meeting minutes: window display rota fixed, Jo to check milk fridge seals weekly, card machine receipt roll reorder point set at two boxes.
Cardamom Kitchen can supply the café with cardamom buns at 1.10 each in trays of 24, delivered Tuesdays and Fridays.
Booked the Tuesday Readers into the Café Room at 18:30 on the first Tuesday of each month through December, as Ruth Ellison asked.
Nimbus Paper invoice 1182: four boxes of Lantern Books carrier bags, 112 pounds, payable by 6 August.
Standing order placed with Cardamom Kitchen: two trays of cardamom buns for the café every Friday, 52.80 per week.
Milk fridge seal replaced this morning; temperature back to 4 degrees by lunch.
Lantern Books will open late on Fridays in November, until 21:00, for the run-up to the winter lists.
Draft for the autumn newsletter: our roastery rep Tessa Vale will host November's cupping evening in the Café Room.
No cardamom bun delivery on Friday 28 August — our oven is being serviced. Back to normal the following week.
Quill & Thread Bindery quotes 6.50 per journal for rebinding the damaged stock batch of 18 journals.
To-do: pay Nimbus Paper invoice 1182 (112 pounds) by 6 September and file the receipt.
Sent the 18 damaged journals to Quill & Thread Bindery for rebinding at 117 pounds total.
Thinking ahead: how about a Christmas blend tasting for your customers on Saturday 5 December? Let me know and I'll pencil it in.
Staff meeting minutes: Jo confirmed she can stay until 22:00 on 20 November for the cupping evening clean-down.
Your September statement is attached — all Thursday deliveries went out on time. As ever, anything you need, I'm your account rep. Tessa Vale.
Ordered six boxes of carrier bags from Nimbus Paper for 168 pounds ahead of the winter lists; under the 500-pound line so no further sign-off needed.

Some news: my last day at Hearth & Vine is 31 October. From 1 November your account rep is Owen Park — owen.park@hearthvine.example, 01473 555 019. Everything else about your account, including delivery terms and the free-delivery minimum, stays exactly as it is.
Invoice 4471 for October's weekly bean deliveries to Lantern Books café: 384 pounds, payable by 14 November.
We'll skip the December meeting — too close to the holidays — and restart in January. November's meeting stands.
Cupping evening prep list started: 40 tasting cups counted, spare grinder blades found, signage still to print.
The rebound journals will be ready 13 November, two days later than planned — apologies for the delay.
To-do: pay Hearth & Vine invoice 4471 (384 pounds) by 14 November.
Your six boxes of carrier bags ship on 12 November; tracking to follow.
Café fridge stocked for the week; bun order arrived Friday as usual.
